releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.2 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Universal Top-Left Ad Close Recognition: Visual and tree perception for top-left glyphs, chevrons, and circular badges
* Zero-Click-Trap Defense: Eliminated blind top-right corner taps that hit Google AdChoices (i) icons
* Auto-Return from Chrome: Automatically dismisses accidental external browser redirects
* Episode Transition Continuity: Full-width container bubbling for 'Continue watching ads' and 'Unlock 2 more Episodes'
* Interrupted Ad Dialog Handling: Auto-resumes paused video if reward not yet granted, auto-closes if reward confirmed
